headline: India exceeded expectations at the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow, securing a total of 39 medals across athletics, shooting, wrestling and other disciplines.
The official Commonwealth Games 2026 website publishes India's comprehensive medals tally and a complete list of gold, silver and bronze winners from Glasgow.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced a nationwide talent hunt for children aged 5‑15, aiming to build a pipeline of athletes for the 2036 Olympic Games.
Sports Minister Mansukh Mandaviya highlighted India's aggressive push to host the 2036 Olympic Games, outlining new infrastructure plans and diplomatic outreach.
AP News reports that India is shifting focus from cricket dominance to broader Olympic ambitions, mapping a strategic play on the global sports stage.
